It POSTs to apiUrl('/ai/chatbot') (== getApiBase()+/api/v1/ai/chatbot, the web fullURL) with Accept:text/event-stream + credentials:include, finalizes to done on body drain, and on a body-less response finalizes with an explicit AI_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE_REASON (never a silent success).
